summary: Moolec Science SA filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its May 13, 2026 virtual annual general meeting. Shareholders voted to approve the FY2025 financial statements, re-elect four directors (Diego Abelleyra Llodra, Oscar Leon Bentancor, Romualdo Varela, and Daniel Core), and re-appoint Price Waterhouse Co. S.R.L. as the independent auditor for FY2026. No material corporate event, transaction, or special situation triggered the filing; it is a routine meeting notice. There are no deal terms, advisor roles, or risk-arb angles.
